components.gaps: No flush alignment (zero inline padding for side panels); heading level fixed at h3 (Radix Header), no `level` prop; no start-side chevron. Extras: icon, description, meta, separated variant.

components.faun: None as a component. Neighbours: `ActorChip`, `ConfidenceBadge`, `StreamingText appearance="draft"`, `CitationMarker`
components.gaps: No `AILabel` (default 16-64 px and inline sizes), no explainability popover (overview, details, artefacts, actions), no revert-to-AI-value control, no AI-presence styling hook on Input, Select, Textarea, Tag, Card or table cells. `ai.*` colour roles exist in tokens but nothing consumes them as a label. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): AILabel (`@faun-ds/ai`): label or icon, agent and model, summary, confidence, sources and revert in one explainability popover; `AISlot` gives fields, tiles and text areas the suggested/accepted/edited treatment. Still open: AI presence on table cells and Tag.
Fixed-ratio media/chart/tile wrapper (16:9, 4:3, 1:1 and inverses). Today consumers set `aspect-ratio` by hand.
No size prop (Carbon sm/md); no explicit mobile rule (collapse to one crumb); long labels rely on CSS ellipsis plus `title`. Overflow menu (first + last two) and `renderLink` router hook are present.

Sizes: only sm 28 / md 32 / lg 40 exposed; xs (24) and xl (48) tokens exist but no prop value; no 2xl. No `ButtonGroup`/button set. `loading` has no finished/error outcome. Label is `white-space: nowrap` (Carbon wraps to a second line). Danger is not blocked from icon-only use. See section 2. Batch 1 (22 Oct 2026): `xs` (24) and `xl` (48) sizes, `wrap` for long labels, `status` success/error with `statusLabel`, `ButtonGroup` (set, joined, equal, stacked), icon-only `danger` removed from the `IconButton` type. Still open: no 2xl, no fluid joined set with 1px separator across a form.

No read-only and no warning state (invalid only); sizes sm/md only; no AI variant. Group has legend, description, error, horizontal, select-all with indeterminate. Batch 1: `warn` message on `CheckboxGroup` and via `Field`, `readOnly` (value kept, `aria-readonly`), `skeleton`. Still open: AI variant.

components.faun: None in the library (a docs-only `CodeBlock` lives in apps/docs; `JsonViewer` has copy)
components.gaps: Inline, single-line (horizontal scroll) and multi-line (show more/less, scroll after ~9 lines) snippets; copy with live "Copied" confirmation; wrap option; on-layer background.

The control is a button that opens a search panel, not an editable input: no typing in the field, no inline autocomplete, no custom value committed on blur/Enter, no multi-token entry. No warn/read-only/fluid. Present: async `onSearchChange`, `loading`, groups, clear button, empty message. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): a real typed field: `input role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete` and `aria-activedescendant`, local filter on label, description and keywords, clear, chevron toggle, polite result count, `allowCustomValue` (opt in; commit on Enter, blur or the Use row; `customValueLabel`), same props as before (`searchPlaceholder` now ignored, ref is the input). Still open: inline autocomplete, multi-token entry.
On-page and disclosed lists with header (title, search, action), row sizes 32-64, inline row actions, optional sticky header, dividers. `Listbox` is internal only.
No high/low contrast pair; selection is activation-only (no auto vs manual choice). Sizes sm/md/lg, icon-only with `aria-label`, disabled per item and whole group are present.

Strong core (sorting, selection, expansion, batch bar, server paging, sticky, resize, column menu, virtualisation). Missing distinct Carbon variants: single-select (radio), built-in toolbar with search and action slot, five row sizes (Faun has three densities), zebra, expand-all, row overflow integration, inline editing, AI presence. Variant breakdown in table 1b. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): single select (`selectionMode="single"`, radio), `toolbar` slot with `DataTableToolbar` (search, filters, actions) that the selection bar replaces while rows are selected, five row sizes (`rowSize` xs 24 to xl 64, `rowSizeMenu`), `zebra`, `stickyFirstColumn`, and `DataTableRowActions`. Still open: expand-all, inline editing, AI presence.

Trigger is a button; no typed or masked text entry, no simple text-only variant, no time picker, no warn/read-only/fluid/skeleton. Present: single and range, presets with fiscal year, min/max, disabled dates, clear, locale, week start, arrow-key grid. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): typed entry with a format mask (`inputFormat`: dd/MM/yyyy, MM/dd/yyyy, yyyy-MM-dd), validation in words (not a real date, before min, after max, disabled) with `aria-invalid`, `onValidate`, calendar button and Alt+Down; range has start and end fields in one box; time picker is C43. Still open: time-zone select, fluid layout check, locale-driven default format.

No inline variant, no warn, no read-only, no fluid. Sizes follow 28/32/40 (Carbon 32/40/48). Groups, descriptions, icons, scroll buttons and keyboard type-ahead are present. Batch 1: `warn`, `readOnly` (focusable, does not open, `aria-readonly`), `skeleton` on Select, Combobox and MultiSelect via the shared state contract; `Field variant="fluid"` styles the trigger. Still open: inline label inside the control, typed entry.

Drop-zone only: no button-only variant (Carbon's default). Per-file queued/uploading/done/error with progress bar, retry and remove are present, plus type, size and count validation. Visible focus on the hidden input is handled (`:has(input:focus-visible)`).

No `Form` anatomy component (header, body, footer, spacing), no form-level error summary component (the pattern composes `Banner`), no multistep/wizard form, no fluid form, no column grid helper. Required and optional markers are both supported. Validation timing differs on purpose (on submit, then live).

States inactive, active, finished, error with a text label ("Saving..." to "Saved"), auto-reset after about 1.5 s, success callback, polite live-region announcement. Batch 1: `InlineLoading` (inactive, active, finished, error; description text; `successDelay` default 1500 ms; `onSuccess`; polite live region, assertive for error).

No visited colour; disabled only through `aria-disabled` styling (no `disabled` prop); no sizes (inherits text); no leading/trailing icon slot except the external icon. Inline vs standalone is covered by `underline="always" / "hover"`.
Ordered/unordered lists with nested levels and the dash/square/number/letter markers; productive and expressive sizes.

No full-screen or container overlay with inert background, no overlay-with-spinner for a region, no documented thresholds (spinner vs skeleton vs progress). Spinner has no determinate form (use `ProgressCircle`).

No size scale matching trigger height (xs-lg); no item-count guard. Present: groups, separators, labels, submenus, checkbox and radio items, danger intent, shortcut hints, descriptions, context menu, type-ahead, matchTriggerWidth.

No `MenuButton` (button with chevron and menu in one) and no `ComboButton` (primary action plus chevron menu); no size tie-in between trigger and item height. Batch 1: `MenuButton` and `ComboButton` (primary action plus chevron menu, named chevron); `DropdownMenuContent size` ties item height to the trigger size.

No `OverflowMenu` (ghost "more" icon button with a fixed accessible label, flip-aware), no hover-reveal in table rows with persistent display on touch, no table-row helper. Needed by every list and table. Batch 1: `OverflowMenu` (required `label`, horizontal and vertical, size-matched menu). Still open (batch 2): hover-reveal in table rows with persistent display on touch, table row helper. Batch 2: `DataTableRowActions` (icon buttons for one or two actions, overflow menu for three or more or any destructive one; hover-reveal on pointer devices that stays visible on focus, while open and always on touch and forced colours; disabled while rows are selected for a batch). Remaining: lists and cards other than DataTable do not have a row helper.

Passive, transactional and danger (typed confirmation, async confirm) are covered. Missing: non-modal dialog, acknowledgement and multi-step (Cancel/Previous/Next) footers as presets, scroll-shadow on the body, full-screen size. Focus trap, Escape, focus return and scrim handling come from Radix. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `size="xs"`, `variant` passive and danger (labelled icon, danger rule), scrolling body that is keyboard reachable with dividers. Still open: non-modal preset, multi-step footer, full-screen size.
No tri-state parent "All" row (a footer has Select all/Clear), no inline variant, no warn, no read-only, no fluid. Chips with +N, search, groups, async, bulk actions are present.

No high/low contrast pair on Banner; no toast timestamp; a toast with an action still auto-dismisses after 5 s (Carbon keeps actionable toasts until dismissed); no callout-specific role (a Banner without `onDismiss` works). Present: 5 tones with icon, actions, dismiss, promise/loading/update API, max stack, swipe, position. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): a toast with an action no longer auto-dismisses (stays until acted on or dismissed); `duration` opts back in to a timer and `persistent` keeps any toast. Still open: toast timestamp. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): Popover `tone` inverse, SVG caret, `arrowPadding`, alignment checked.

components.faun: None (pattern text mentions a notification centre)
components.gaps: Chronological list grouped by time/source/urgency, read state, preferences link, unread dot on trigger, works alongside toasts. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `NotificationPanel`, `NotificationList`, `NotificationItem`, `NotificationBell`: grouped by time, read state, actions, mark all as read.
No warn, no fluid. Present: min/max clamp, step and Shift x10, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End, locale formatting on blur, unit and prefix, steppers, read-only, `aria-valuenow`/`valuetext`.

No size prop to match table density; no jump-to-page select; no looping; no unknown-total ("unbound") mode. Page buttons with ellipsis, items per page, summary, compact variant and live announcements are present.
No tab-tip variant (attached to a toolbar/header), no inverse/high-contrast style, no flush "no tip" alignment. Arrow, close button, sizes, header/body/footer, collision handling present.

No status prop: no success/error state with icon and required helper text (tone is colour-only, against Faun's own icon-plus-label rule); no inline/indent label alignment. Determinate, indeterminate, value label, segments, ARIA are present. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `status` (`active`, `finished`, `error`) with icon plus text ("Finished", "Failed" or `statusText`), `aria-valuetext`, and an announcement contract (silent on mount; "in progress" on turning indeterminate; 25, 50 and 75 percent milestones; finished polite; failed as an alert; `announce={false}`). Still open: inline and indent label alignment.

No disabled step, no arrow-key movement between interactive steps (steps are buttons in tab order), no secondary label slot beyond description. States complete, current, upcoming, error and awaiting-human; horizontal and vertical; interactive via `onSelect`. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): disabled step (`disabled`, reads Unavailable) and `showStatus` for visible text status. Still open: arrow-key movement between interactive steps, secondary label slot.

No warn, no read-only. Vertical and horizontal, card (tile) variant with icon and meta, helper text, group error present. Batch 1: `warn`, `readOnly` (`aria-readonly`, selection kept), `skeleton` on `RadioGroup`.

Sizes sm/md/lg (Carbon xs-lg); no expandable (icon-collapse) variant, no scope select, no fluid, no results-panel behaviour (active/focused search) outside `CommandPalette`. Clear, Escape, Enter to `onSearch`, loading, shortcut hint present.

components.faun: `Select` is Radix-based; no native `<select>` component (Pagination uses an unstyled one)
components.gaps: No `NativeSelect` for mobile pickers and plain forms; inline, warn, read-only, fluid shared with C13.
No paired number input(s) (Carbon default), no read-only, no warn. Single and range, marks with labels, vertical, `onValueCommit`, `formatValue`, per-thumb labels present.

components.faun: None (`DescriptionList` is key-value; a compact `DataTable` covers most uses)
components.gaps: Header row with columns, condensed and flush modes, selectable single-row list with radio/check icon.

No dismissible tabs, no secondary label, no scroll arrows (Faun scrolls with edge fades), manual-activation mode not documented (Radix `activationMode` passes through), vertical is line-only, no icon-only guard. Line, contained, segmented, sm/md, icon, count, end slot present.

Read-only (default/framework/brand), dismissible and selectable (`FilterChip`) exist. Missing: operational tag (opens a popover/modal of more tags), the hue palette (Carbon ~12 colours; Faun 3 variants, status colour lives on `Badge`), lg size, truncation with tooltip, disabled, skeleton, inline AI label. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): Selectable, dismissible, operational and filter variants, lg, disabled, and `TagGroup` with a +N popover.

No warn, no password toggle, no inline label, no fluid, no character counter on the single-line input, no skeleton, no AI label. Invalid, read-only styling, disabled, helper, prefix/suffix, numeric alignment present. See section 2. Batch 1: `warn`, shared read-only style (also Textarea), `skeleton`, `showCount` counter on `Input`, password toggle, Field `inline` and `fluid` variants. Still open: word counter, AI label and revert.

Show/hide toggle (pressed state, accessible name), requirement helper text, autocomplete hints (`current-password`, `new-password`). Batch 1: `PasswordInput` and `type="password"` toggle with changing accessible name, custom labels, `autoComplete` default. Requirement helper text is the Field description.

No word counter, no read-only styling (native attribute passes through but nothing marks it), no warn, no skeleton. Character counter with polite near-limit message, auto-grow, resize control present.

Clickable works through `asChild`. No `SelectableTile` (radio/check icon, hover-selected state, multi-select), no `ExpandableTile`, no disabled state. Single-select cards exist only inside `RadioGroup variant="card"`. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `ClickableTile` (link or button), `SelectableTile` with checkbox semantics alone or in `TileGroup type="checkbox"` and radio semantics in `TileGroup type="radio"` (native inputs, fieldset legend, disabled, read-only, filled check or dot indicator), `ExpandableTile` (button with `aria-expanded`, region). Still open: tile-level AI label.

Hour/minute entry with 12/24 h, AM/PM and time-zone selects, validation. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `TimePicker`: masked hh:mm field, 12 or 24 hour (`hourCycle`, AM/PM select, A and P keys), `step` with Arrow Up and Down, `min`, `max`, validation in words, `onValidate`, value always 24 hour HH:mm. Still open: time-zone select, a list of slots.
No state text ("On"/"Off"), no read-only, no skeleton. Sizes sm/md, label position, description, disabled present.

components.faun: None (`Popover` is the base; `HoverCard` is hover-only)
components.gaps: No `Toggletip`: info icon button that opens a small popover on click/Enter/Space, may hold actions, Escape closes, content announced politely. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `Toggletip`: button trigger, non-modal popover, Escape and focus return.
Icon tooltip behaviour is built into `IconButton`. Delay, side, align, Escape, shortcut hint present; content is deliberately non-interactive. Definition tooltip is separate (C47).
Dotted-underline term whose definition opens on hover, focus or click. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `DefinitionTooltip`: dotted-underline term, definition on focus, hover and tap.

No xs size, no multi-select or checkbox tree, no async/lazy children, collapsed parent does not inherit the selected state of a hidden descendant. WAI-ARIA tree keys (arrows, Home/End, `*`, type-ahead), guides, icons, meta present.

No header navigation links with dropdown sub-menus, no defined utilities order (search left, switcher right), no unread badge slot on header icons. Nav toggle, breadcrumbs slot, search slot, actions slot, skip link and `<header>` landmark present. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `HeaderNav` links with current page and collapse below 768, `HeaderActions`, `SkipLink`.

Items are flat links: no expandable groups or second tier. Present: icon rail with tooltips, mobile drawer with inert page and focus return, sections, counts, attention badges, `aria-current`, workspace and user blocks. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `SideNavGroup` second tier: collapsible, current page marked, flyout popover in the collapsed rail.

Right panel anchored to a header icon, one open at a time, outlined trigger, closes on item select or trigger press. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `HeaderPanel` with `useHeaderPanel`, one panel open at a time, focus return.
No switcher panel: recent/frequent/all products, dividers, far-right placement rule. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `SwitcherPanel`: grouped product list with current marked.
No per-component skeleton states (input, button, tag, tile, list) and no card preset. Text, circle, rect, multi-line and table shapes present.
Pill chrome only: no chrome-less inline icon + label form, one icon size. 20 status icons across 7 tones, always icon plus label, from the status map.
Only a round dot, so meaning rests on colour; Carbon varies the shape and outlines light tones. No dedicated component or shape set.
No badge overlay for `IconButton` (header and toolbar icons); no overflow cap rule (99+).
Direction arrow plus sentiment colour present. No standalone inline `Delta` for table cells.
Gap from the space scale, align, justify, wrap, `asChild`. No responsive gap values.
Wide, narrow, condensed modes; 4/8/12 columns; offsets; per-breakpoint spans. No subgrid helper, no `Layer` component.
Fluid text input, text area, dropdown, select, number, date, search, time, form: label inside the field, 64 px height, helper in a tooltip.
Icon button with "Copied" feedback and live-region announcement; shared by snippets, IDs and tables.

`role="toolbar"` container with roving tabindex, arrow-key movement, overflow into a menu. Needed by table toolbars and the text-toolbar pattern. Batch 3 (22 Oct 2026): `Toolbar`, `ToolbarButton`, `ToolbarSeparator`: roving tabindex, overflow menu. Overflow tested with stubbed widths only.
Side panel covered. No tearsheet (large overlay stacking above a page with steps) and no stacked-panel behaviour.

dataTableVariants.gaps: No xs 24 or xl 64 rows; header height does not separate from rows. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `rowSize` xs 24, sm 32, md 40, lg 48, xl 64 px from control-size tokens, overriding density; header height unchanged.

dataTableVariants.faun: `selectable`, indeterminate header, per-page vs all semantics
dataTableVariants.gaps: Header checkbox labelled; selection survives paging.
Radio column, one row at a time. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `selectionMode="single"`: radio column, no select-all or bar, arrow keys move between rows, Space chooses.

dataTableVariants.faun: Selection bar with count, Clear selection, `selectionActions` slot
dataTableVariants.gaps: Does not take over the toolbar; row-level actions are not disabled in batch mode; no Cancel wording. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): the selection bar replaces the toolbar strip while rows are selected, and row actions switch off in batch mode.
No expand-all control in the header.

dataTableVariants.faun: `SearchField` placed above the table by the consumer
dataTableVariants.gaps: No toolbar slot inside the table surface; no collapsible active-search. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): search lives in `DataTableToolbar` (a `SearchField` in the `search` slot), inside the table surface. Collapsible active-search is not built.

No `toolbar` slot, no overflow into a menu, no size pairing with row height. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `toolbar` slot with search, filters and actions, plus the Row height menu (`rowSizeMenu`); the strip wraps on narrow screens. No overflow-into-menu (the Toolbar primitive is still open).
No sticky first column or sticky toolbar. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `stickyFirstColumn` pins the selection and first data columns. Sticky toolbar not built.

dataTableVariants.faun: Client and server (`totalRows`), page size options, announcements
dataTableVariants.gaps: Pagination size does not follow row size.
Optional alternating row background. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `zebra`, by data position, under hover and selected.

Persistent vs hover-reveal, disabled in batch mode, icon buttons when fewer than three. Batch 2 (22 Oct 2026): `DataTableRowActions`: persistent or hover-reveal, always visible on touch, on focus and while open; disabled in batch mode; icon buttons when fewer than three actions, otherwise `OverflowMenu`.
Editable cells with commit/cancel and validation.
AI label on table, column, row or cell.

patterns.carbon: Common actions (add, cancel, clear, close, copy, delete, edit, errors, next, refresh, remove, reset)
patterns.gaps: No pattern page for the 12 actions. Delete tiering exists in part (reversible vs typed confirmation). No copy-with-tooltip feedback, no refresh, reset or remove guidance.

patterns.carbon: Dialogs (modal passive, transactional, acknowledgement, progress; non-modal)
patterns.gaps: Only the confirm case is a pattern. No guidance for passive, acknowledgement, progress or non-modal, nor button placement rules.

Disabled is documented; read-only and hidden-by-permission rules are not, and read-only is implemented on only two controls. Batch 1: read-only is now documented and implemented on all 13 control families. Still open: hidden-by-permission rule.

patterns.carbon: Disclosures (profile menu, settings/filter popover, combo button, toggletip)
patterns.gaps: No pattern page; combo button and toggletip components missing; no rule set (one open at a time, no nesting, width cap).
Four kinds, sizes sm/md, actions. Missing the in-depth alternatives (in-line documentation, onboarding, starter content); the Home pattern shows a first-use hint set.
Chips, add menu and Clear all are good. No batch mode with Apply, no filter drawer/popover with applied-count on the trigger, no per-category reset, no range (date, number) filters, no saved views.
Covers labels, required/optional, error summary banner, save. Missing: dialog vs side panel vs multistep guidance, wizard, button placement and spacing rules, fluid forms.
See C49 to C52.

patterns.carbon: Loading (skeleton, indicators, progress, progressive, load more)
patterns.gaps: Components exist; no pattern page with thresholds; no inline loading, overlay or load-more.
Progressive/SSO/password variants, centred and split layouts, server error handling, generic credentials message.
Toast vs banner vs notification centre vs dialog is explained. The notification centre has no component (C26).

Styled read-only exists on two of the 13 control families (Input, NumberField); Textarea, Select, Combobox, MultiSelect, DatePicker, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Slider have none. Batch 1: read-only styling and semantics on all 13 families (native `readonly` where the element supports it; `aria-readonly` plus blocked changes elsewhere).

patterns.carbon: Search (basic, active, focused, scoped, recent, no results)
patterns.gaps: Command palette is solid. No results-page, active-search panel, scope filter with counts, recent/trending searches or zero-result guidance.
Formatting toolbar pattern (needs `Toolbar`, rich-text surface).

patterns.carbon: Status indicators (icon, shape, badge, differential; severity tiers)
patterns.gaps: Icon + label, 7 tones, domain/state map. Gaps: shape indicator set, notification badge, a pattern page stating severity tiers and the five-or-six-per-view limit.

patterns.carbon: Overflow content (truncation, show more, ellipsis menu)†
patterns.gaps: No `Truncate` (end, middle, front), no `ShowMore`/load-more, no rule for tooltips on truncated text. Batch 1: `Truncate` (end, middle, start, multi-line, tooltip only when cut, focusable while cut) and `ShowMore` (line clamp, toggle only when cut). Load-more for lists is not part of this.

patterns.faun: "Settings form" (explicit save; Switch applies at once)
patterns.gaps: No inline edit, autosave, unsaved-changes guard, or saving/saved feedback pattern.
No sortable list, drop target or keyboard-operable reorder; column resize is the only drag.

patterns.carbon: Data table patterns (bulk, list and detail, empty, filtering)†
patterns.faun: "Bulk actions on a table", "List and detail"
patterns.gaps: Bulk and list-detail covered; toolbar, inline editing, row actions and filtering patterns absent.

patterns.carbon: Generative AI patterns (AI label, explainability, revert, feedback, chat)†
patterns.gaps: Run, approval, provenance, confidence and streaming are ahead of Carbon. Missing: AI label and explainability popover, revert, feedback controls (helpful, copy, regenerate), suggested prompts component, message list/bubbles, reasoning disclosure, AI-presence styling.
Components exist; no page on choosing between them.
